title: Phosphorus is the unique biological neural qubit

statements.text: Phosphorus is the unique biological element whose nuclear spin can serve as a qubit for putative quantum processing in the brain, because a spin one half nucleus has no electric quadrupole moment and is decohered only by weaker magnetic fields.

sources.quote: Phosphorus is identified as the unique biological element with a nuclear spin that can serve as a qubit for such putative quantum processing - a neural qubit
